title: Schema forms outside the subset, for lint fixtures
description: Test helper: $defs entries for the violating fixtures in ../rules/ that reach a schema of a .json file through $ref, the way the contracts reach ../../schemas/*.json. No contract references this file. Every entry is a variant for the violating fixture named in its description; AnyValue, the boolean schema true, cannot have one: it serves contracts--subset-boolean-schema--through-ref.

Rooms.description: rule--subset-forbidden-keywords--nested-defs: the entry keeps the schema of count in a $defs of its own, below the top level of the file.
